verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment confirming that a public status page exists at status.aws.amazon.com. The same comment complains it shows every service green during real outages, which undercuts the 'real' status surface the story asks for. No first-party documentation in the pack describes the status/health surface, so this cannot be a vendor-claimed dispute, only thin partial support. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the status/health dashboard, per-service incident history, published post-incident reports, and independent evidence that the page reflects outages accurately.
